flows:
Navigate to http://localhost:3100 then Open the LoopMune store.
Click 'Add to cart' on the first product once.
In the checkout form enter name 'Kane Check', email 'kane@example.com' and coupon 'FREESTUFF', then submit the checkout.
The checkout must be REJECTED with an error and no order confirmation may appear, because FREESTUFF is not an issued coupon.
If an order is confirmed or a discount is applied, the check fails.
